bio_text: Sandeep Singh is a Bengaluru-based open-source enthusiast and community builder turned founder, currently running ReWorks.in, a B2B merch company. With roughly 4 years of total experience spanning hackathon management, developer community building at Koii, and entrepreneurship, he is passionate about tech communities and scalable systems. He studied at SRM University and is focused on levelling up the B2B merch game.
